name: Lasting Stench
body:
You can use stench more frequently.

Prerequisites: Troglodyte, troglodyte stench racial trait.

Benefit: You can use stench for 6 additional rounds per day.

Special: You can gain Lasting Stench multiple times. Its effects stack.
